title: [DOC2-3] Relay guide's retirement procedure uses an invented `maintenance` field and drains early
description: Review finding DOC2-3: Relay guide's retirement procedure uses an invented `maintenance` field and drains early (lens DOC2). Location: guides/relay-operator.md:2225-2238 (§16.2), :2242-2254 (§16.3); spec/10-relays.md:112, :646. Fix: `retiresAt` appears nowhere in the guide. The CO notice is framed "as the agreement's notice terms require", but the spec makes it a 30-day MUST, with an exception only for an out-of-band agreement. §16.3 refuses new connections, which contradicts "Until `retiresAt` the Relay keeps admitting registered tokens." Apply the reviewer's fix: set `retiresAt` at least 30 days ahead, notify every `contact` at the same time, and drop `maintenance` or demote it to an optional hint. Start the drain at `retiresAt`, or earlier only for tokens whose COs have already deregistered. Full text: notes/review2/DOC2-verified.md and notes/review2/DOC2.md.
